notes.title: Update Notes:
notes.content: This update resolves an issue where some players with non-English language system settings are unable to launch Republique VR.

notes.title: Republique VR is now available!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Republique VR, a re-imagined and re-tooled VR version of Camouflaj's first title, is available now. We hope that long-time Republique fans enjoy this new take on our game. If you've never played Republique before, great news: you can download Republique free of charge with the purchase of Republique VR, and experience the original as well.

Republique VR includes a host of new features and upgrades to the original title, including:

[list]
[*] Re-imagined puzzles and art created specifically for VR
[/list]
[list]
[*] All new VR-themed game collectibles
[/list]
[list]
[*] Chinese language support
[/list]
[list]
[*] Hundreds of bug fixes
[/list]

It's been a long time coming, and we're incredibly pleased to finally bring Republique VR to Steam for our fans to enjoy. Thank you so much for your support over the years, and a HUGE thanks for our development partners at Darkwind Media for their brilliant work on this game.

Thanks for playing...and watch your step.

[i]- Paul + the Camouflaj team[/i]
